text: うみも　いいけど　じつは　やまも　すきだな！

structure.en: the sea is good too, but

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two halves of a sentence with 'but'. いいけど = 'it's good, but'

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker voicing his own feeling, half to himself. すきだな = 'I do like them, you know'
